about: Demo-mode stand-in for the two model calls (extract, rate) on the 16 seed applicants. Each row is one quote copied verbatim from the applicant's own anonymized documents, the indicator it speaks to, and the level observed on that indicator. backend/ledger/demo.py runs these rows through the real quote check, level rules and ATOLA checklist. Used only while no model key is set and no cached run exists.
